title: Original shapes, one ink
question: No colour, no faces: four sets in one ink with original, gently wavy but clean shapes, on the same two-tone grainy background. Each card shows the board by day, the drawer at night, and the set. Pick one, or steer (for example: Onde with Galets' frames).

options.label: Onde
options.lineage: Water at rest: every straight line takes one soft wave
options.thesis: Every straight line becomes a gentle wave and every frame swells a little, like a cushion; one even line everywhere, round ends, nothing else.
materials: one soft wave per straight line
options.viewport: Board by day: wavy menu, cushion checkboxes, wavy list lines in the bottom bar. Drawer at night: the same waves in light ink.
options.risk: The waves have to stay this small; any bigger and it turns wobbly, which you turned down for the cards.
options.case: The most direct answer: original at a glance, still clean and calm at 16px.

options.label: Pinceau
options.lineage: Calligraphy with a broad nib: thick and thin strokes
options.thesis: The same soft curves drawn with a broad nib held at an angle: thick downstrokes, thin hairlines, softened ends, like ink in a carnet.
materials: thick and thin from a pen angle
options.viewport: Board by day with calligraphic icons and checkboxes; the drawer at night in light ink.
options.risk: At 24px the thick strokes get inky and small inner details merge.
options.case: The most distinctive and the most hand-made, without leaving one ink.

options.label: Molle
options.lineage: Soft modelling clay, in one colour
options.thesis: Solid, soft shapes with gently swelling edges and rounded ends, the details cut out; friendly and calm.
options.viewport: Board by day with solid soft icons; the drawer at night in light ink.
options.risk: The closest to ordinary filled icons; the softness mostly shows at large sizes.
options.case: Very legible, the most solid presence in the bars.

options.label: Galets
options.lineage: The brand's pebble as the shape of everything
options.thesis: Every frame is the mark's smooth pebble: the photo, the magnifier, the archive box, the bin, the checkbox; lines stay even and clean.
materials: the mark's pebble as every frame
solid pebbles for the small things
options.viewport: Board by day with pebble checkboxes and a pebble photo; the drawer at night in light ink.
options.risk: Round frames lose some recognition (the bin reads a little like a jar), and marks inside a round frame can look like a face; I reshaped Photo and Notes for that.
options.case: Ties the icons to the logo: the same stone everywhere.
